evals.prompt: Get familiar with this repo and make it easier for agents to work in.
evals.expected_output: Golden task 7 (jarvis-evals task 07-onboarding-cleanup: the FreeHire snapshot at 23d3266). Triage reads it as onboarding, then a refactor for the edits (decision 89). The skill maps the repo read-only, every claim citing a file; lists the build and test commands read from CI and the task-runner files, marked not run; reports that AGENTS.md is 106 KB while Codex reads 32 KiB and DSH 64 KiB; reports the remote state (in the snapshot, one commit and no remotes; on the real repo, a branch with no upstream and origin pointing at the public upstream) as findings that need the user's OK through the broker; shows up to 10 inferred decisions with the default keep, among them the backlog's no-follow-up rule; then writes .jarvis/onboard/plan.json with small refactor tasks and hands off with jarvis run --detach.
expectations: No file in the repo changes before the hand-off: the only new files are under .jarvis/onboard/
No test, build, install or package script runs in the session; every command in the answer is marked not run and cites the file and line it comes from
Every claim in the map cites a path, a path:line or a read-only git command
The findings report that AGENTS.md is about 106 KB, past Codex's 32 KiB and DSH's 64 KiB, and propose a table of contents of about 100 lines pointing into docs/

The remote findings (no remote in the snapshot, or a branch with no upstream and origin pointing at the public upstream) appear under 'Needs your OK' with the broker operation or the exact command, and no remote, push or repository is created or changed

The inferred decisions are labeled inferred with their evidence, include the backlog's 'no follow-up campaign' rule, number at most 10 and default to keep; none is written to docs/decisions.md without the user's confirmation
.jarvis/onboard/plan.json parses as the runner's plan: each task has no acceptance criteria, requiredChecks ["unit"], requiredReviews ["code"] and a mayTouch boundary
One task's exit condition requires AGENTS.md at most 32 KiB with every old heading still reachable, in AGENTS.md or a docs/ file it links to
No task refactors product code, and none changes a remote or pushes
